description: LICHEN replay window test vectors (spec 4.4 Epoch and Sequence Number). Validates 32-slot window, 24-bit logical counter epoch<<16|seqnum, per-peer tracking, and epoch acceptance rules. Spec defines Window as 32-bit bitmap (spec/02-physical-link.md:332). Task label '64-slot' is stale; implementation correctly uses 32 per spec.
ordering: ordinary unsigned integer ordering, not serial-number arithmetic

vectors.name: logical_counter_combine
vectors.description: 24-bit logical counter is (epoch << 16) | seqnum with unsigned ordering

vectors.name: first_frame_accepted
vectors.description: First frame from a sender is always accepted

vectors.name: strictly_increasing_all_accepted
vectors.description: Monotonic seqnum in same epoch all accepted

vectors.name: higher_epoch_accepted_even_with_lower_seqnum
vectors.description: Higher epoch is always accepted even if seqnum is lower

vectors.name: lower_epoch_rejected
vectors.description: Lower epoch is always stale and rejected

vectors.name: lower_epoch_rejected_at_adjacent_boundary
vectors.description: Epoch 4 with max seqnum still rejected when last epoch is 5

vectors.name: higher_epoch_resets_window
vectors.description: Epoch increment resets bitmap; same seqnum in new epoch is fresh

vectors.name: same_epoch_sequence_wrap_rejected
vectors.description: Seqnum 0 after 65535 in same epoch is not a wrap; rejected as old

vectors.name: terminal_counter_wrap_rejected
vectors.description: After (255,65535) => (0,0) is rejected; key rotation required

vectors.name: out_of_order_within_window_accepted_once
vectors.description: Out-of-order within 32-slot window accepted exactly once

vectors.name: below_window_floor_rejected
vectors.description: Seqnum 1 with last=40 is offset 39 >= 32 => too old

vectors.name: window_floor_edge
vectors.description: Offset == WINDOW_SIZE is rejected; offset == WINDOW_SIZE-1 accepted

vectors.name: large_jump_resets_window
vectors.description: Jump > window_size resets bitmap; old slots become too old

vectors.name: per_peer_isolation
vectors.description: Per-peer windows: same counter from different peers both accepted; replay per peer isolated

vectors.name: epoch_persistence_across_restarts
vectors.description: With persisted epoch, sender resumes above last counter; without persistence, random init in [128,255]

vectors.name: epoch_recovery_after_flash_failure
vectors.description: Flash read failure falls back to random epoch in [128,255]; receiver may reject; sender must rotate key if cannot establish fresh counter
vectors.scenario: cold boot without flash or flash read failure => epoch = secrets.randbelow(128)+128

vectors.name: cross_validate_rust_python_zephyr
vectors.description: All implementations must produce identical accept/reject for these cases

epoch_persistence.python: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py: _load_persisted_state/_save_persisted_state via JSON file; random epoch 128-255 on cold boot via secrets.randbelow
epoch_persistence.rust: rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs: load_epoch/save_epoch (id.epoch); seqnum persisted via LinkLayer state
epoch_persistence.zephyr: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/epoch_persist.c: lichen_link_epoch_advance_for_boot() loads persisted +1 via settings subsystem; flash failure falls back to random 128-255 in link_ctx.c:202
